user.title: Conectar con Reve
user.description: Introduce tu API key personal de Reve. Actúa como pasarela: después podrás añadir cargadores con su EVSE id.

data_description.rate_tier: Standard keys allow 5 requests per URL and hour, special keys 100. This limits how often chargers can be polled.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The API key was rejected. Enter a valid key.

error.cannot_connect: No se pudo conectar con la API de Reve.
error.rate_limited: Cuota de peticiones agotada. Inténtalo más tarde.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.

user.title: Añadir cargador
user.description: Introduce el EVSE id del cargador, p. ej. `ES*IBD*E142206*1`.

error.invalid_evse_id: Not a valid EVSE id. Expected a format like ES*IBD*E142206*1.
error.evse_not_found: No charger with that EVSE id was found.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Reve API.
error.rate_limited: The API request quota is exhausted. Try again later.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to poll the chargers. The minimum ({minimum} min) keeps requests inside your API quota.

invalid_duration.message: The duration must be greater than zero and at most 7 days.

watch_availability.name: Avisar cuando esté disponible
watch_availability.description: Get notified when the charger becomes available within the given time.

duration.name: Watch for
duration.description: How long to keep watching (max 7 days).

notify_entity_id.name: Notify entities
notify_entity_id.description: Notify entities to alert. If empty, a persistent notification is created.

message.name: Message
message.description: Custom message. Defaults to a message saying the charger is now available.
